description: Search for stocks, ETFs, and companies by name or ticker symbol.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = curated default set

lang.description: Target language for translated text fields (BCP 47, e.g. "ja", "zh-Hant"); English or omitted = no translation

limit.description: Maximum quotes per page; omitted = curated default (25)

query.description: Search query string (company name or ticker symbol)

name: search
title: Symbol Search
